fusions.name: Heavy Draw
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow drawn to the full that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Splitting Shaft
fusions.desc: Looses a massive shaft at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Overdraw
fusions.desc: Increases your piercing damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Tight
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
